response_raw:
user_guided_transport
agents:
	humans: Human1
	robots: Robot1
locations: bedroom, kitchen
resources: object
Human1 default stop:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	3: moveTo kitchen
Robot1 default stop:
	1: moveTo bedroom
	2: pick object
	3: follow Human1 (kitchen)
success: position(Human1, kitchen) && position(Robot1, kitchen) && possess(Robot1, object)
failure: position(Robot1, kitchen) && !possess(Robot1, object)
